Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left-turn lane when the vehicle turned across the path of Driver 2, and the front of Driver
1's vehicle struck the side of Driver 2's vehicle at the intersection in Pearland, Texas. Driver 1 reported neck pain at
the scene and was evaluated by emeregncy medical personnel. The reported injury is consistent with the type and
force of this impact. Driver 1 and Driver 2 both stated that a Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time,
and the Passenger's presence was confirmed by both drivers. No independent witnesses were located at the scene.
Scene photographs confirm the positions of both vehicles and several areas of damage, and the visible damage is
largely in line with the described collision. Neither driver reported, and the responding officer did not observe, any
prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 2 is the named policyholder on the inusrance policy for the vehicle and resides
in the same household as Driver 1. Citations were not issued at the scene pending further review of the collision.
